column1: # The classical canon: composers whose pieces leave Top Charts for the
# Classical tab. Keyed by MusicBrainz artist MBID, never by name — MusicBrainz
# names Tchaikovsky in Cyrillic, Chopin "Fryderyk", Bartók "Bartók Béla", and
# writes Saint‐Saëns with U+2010, so a name list matches a third of them.
# Columns (tab-separated): mbid, display name, birth year, aliases, born, died,
# gender, country (ISO 3166-1) — the last four from the MusicBrainz mirror
# (export 20261114), so anniversaries and the period, living and country charts
# Aliases are the spellings sources actually send (Spotify, Plex, scrobblers),
# pipe-separated, matched against a whole credited name — never a substring, so
# "Bach" is J.S. Bach and "Sebastian Bach" (Skid Row) is not.
# Beyond this list, a piece is still classical when MusicBrainz types its work
# as a symphony, concerto, mass and so on — see `classify::CLASSICAL_WORK_TYPES`.
